summary: 3 E Network Technology Group Ltd filed a 6-K disclosing that its wholly owned BVI subsidiary, 3e Network Technology Holdings Limited, entered a September 3, 2026 Share Subscription Agreement with hashbeaver tech Limited. The subsidiary will subscribe 1,600,000 ordinary shares for US$1,600,000 cash, implying a US$31,600,000 post-investment valuation, giving the Company 9.7% of the Target's enlarged issued share capital. Payment is due within thirty days. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch completion and Register of Members update, minority-stake governance limits, and integration risk.
